text: The corrected reland returns false when direct internal-key-token creation fails and removes the first landing's early unchecked Login(false). The remaining checked login and account authentication state update retain their order. Exact comparison separates this native correction from the seven JavaScript result blobs shared with the first landing. The accepted helper later uses NSS slot APIs, so this historical correction does not claim current token API or runtime equivalence.
title: The corrected key-token reland rejects token creation failure
